title: Mali: Damning evidence of war crimes by state armed forces and Wagner Group personnel – new report
content:
• Killings of civilians during military joint operations
  • Civilians tortured to death in detention, others subjected to simulated drowning, beatings and electric shocks
  • Fulani, Arabs and Tuaregs targeted  

    • Members of Mali’s armed forces working together with personnel from the Wagner Group committed war crimes, including the murder and torture of civilians, during joint operations between 2023 and 2025, Amnesty International said in a new report.

    ‘No one is spared’: War crimes committed by the Malian army and foreign allied forces along the Mauritanian border documents the killings of at least 34 civilians in seven localities in Mali between June 2023 and December 2025, committed by the Malian armed forces (Forces armées maliennes – FAMa) and the Wagner Group (a Russian private military company active in Mali between late 2021 and June 2025).

    The report also documents other serious violations of international humanitarian law and international human rights law, such as torture, enforced disappearance, and the pillaging and destruction of civilian property.

title: Yleisö ja esiintyjät vietiin metsään liki 700 kilometriä Helsingistä – tällaista festivaalia ei olisi ilman Suomussalmea ja sen aktiiveja
content:
Kahdeksannen kerran järjestetyn Pakko sanoa! -festivaalin teemana oli tänä vuonna metsässä. Sinne vietiin sekä esiintyjät että yleisö.

Metsien suojelu ja luontokato ovat muun muassa raakkutuhojen myötä olleet viime vuosina paljon esillä. Päivä Suomussalmella pidetyn festivaalin päättymisen jälkeen teema näyttäytyy yhä ajankohtaisempana:

Orpon hallitus on EU:n biodiversiteettistrategian mukaisesti luvannut suojella kaikki luonnontilaiset ja vanhat metsät, mutta Helsingin Sanomien selvityksen mukaan Metsähallitus on rajannut metsiä suojelun ulkopuolelle, jos niille on suunnitteilla muuta käyttöä – kuten matkailurakentamista ja kaavamerkintöjä.

Suomussalmellakin Metsähallitus on jo aiemmin tehnyt hakkuuilmoituksia muun muassa Kaupinlammen luonnonmetsäalueelle.

METSÄUUTISISSA käytettyjen kaltaisia kiertoilmauksia, kuten ”tarkoituksenmukaisuusharkinta” ja “maankäytöllinen ristiriita”, kuullaan myös Pakko sanoa! -festivaalin aloittaneessa Teatteri Terran Starman-esityksessä.

Teksti on sama kuin Martti Suosalon huikean suosion saavuttaneessa, samannimisessä monologiesityksessä.

title: Yhteisöveron alennus halutaan perua uusista havainnoista huolimatta
content:
Useat julkisuudessa kantansa ilmaisseet taloustutkijat näyttävät olevan sitä mieltä, että yhteisöveron lasku on väärää politiikka. Etlan mielestä alennus on tarpeellinen osa suurempaa kasvupakettia. Suosituksen suunta näyttää riippuvan siitä, kuinka laaja-alaisesti muutoksen vaikutukset otetaan huomioon, kirjoittaa Etla-kolumnissaan Aki Kangasharju.

Etla taitaa olla talouspolitiikan arviointineuvoston (2026) kanssa ainoa taho, joka on ilmaissut yhteisöveron alennuksen Suomeen sopivaksi politiikaksi.[1]

Kriitikot vetoavat tutkimuksiin[2], joiden mukaan yhteisöveron lasku ei nosta tarpeeksi yhteisöveron pohjaa. Toisin sanoen yhteisöveron alentaminen ei kannusta yrityksiä kasvamaan – ja sitä kautta lisäämään voittojaan riittävästi, jotta alemman yhteisöveroprosentin vaikutus verotuloihin kompensoituisi. Vaikutus kompensoituisi, jos voitot kasvaisivat niin paljon, että alemmasta prosentista huolimatta voitoista perittävän yhteisöveron tuottoa kertyisi valtiolle entiseen malliin.

title: Teatteri Imatran kauden 2026–2027 kummiluokka teki ensimmäisen vierailunsa teatteriin viime viikolla
content:
Teatteri Imatra on jatkanut kummiluokkatoimintaansa vuoden tauon jälkeen. Tänä vuonna teatterin kummiluokaksi valikoitui 7A-luokka Mansikkalan koulukeskuksesta. Ensimmäisellä tapaamiskerralla oppilaat pääsivät tutustumaan teatteritaloon ja sen toimintaan.

Luokka kokoontui viime keskiviikkona teatterin lämpiöön, jossa oli vastassa teatterinjohtaja Timo Rissanen ja hallintoassistentti Marika Spencer. Osa oppilaista oli vieraillut teatteritalossa aiemminkin, mutta monelle käynti oli ensimmäinen. Tunnelma oli aluksi jännittynyt, mutta kierroksen edetessä oppilaat rohkaistuivat esittämään toinen toistaan kinkkisempiä kysymyksiä.

Kierroksella oppilaat kiersivät oikeastaan koko teatteritalon tilat läpi aina suuresta näyttämöstä puvustamoon ja näyttelijöiden pukuhuoneista tarpeistovarastoon.

– Olin todella iloinen siitä, kuinka kiinnostuneita oppilaat olivat teatterista ja sen toiminnasta, Rissanen iloitsee.

title: BIOS-tutkimusyksikön Ville Lähde vastaa kiperiin kysymyksiin ilmastokriisistä
content:
1. Kritisoitte kirjassa yhden ­totuuden ympäristö­ajattelua, kuten sitä, että ongelmiin olisi olemassa vain yksi juurisyy. Miksi yksinkertaistaminen on vahingollista?

Yksinkertaistaminen on välttämätöntä, mutta se ei saa olla tyhmistävää ja paikoilleen jumittavaa. Ajattelu on toki helpompaa, jos katsoo maailmaa vain yhden teorian läpi. Ympäristökriisissä täytyy kuitenkin pitää mielessä monta totuutta yhtä aikaa ja suhteuttaa niitä toisiinsa.

2. Miten ympäristökriisi poikkeaa muista yhteiskunnallisista kriiseistä, jotka maailma on yrittänyt ratkaista?

Poliittinen mielikuvituksemme on tottunut tarkastelemaan oikeuksien, vapauksien ja tasa-arvon kaltaisia kysymyksiä, ja aineellisella maailmalla on ollut siinä vain sivurooli. Ympäristökriisi on ensimmäinen iso poliittinen kysymys, jossa aineellinen maailma vaikuttaa omalla painollaan koko ajan. Orjuuden vastaista kamppailua voitiin käydä satoja vuosia, ympäristökriisissä kamppailu muuttaa joka vuosi ­muotoaan.

3. Miten tulevaisuutta voi hahmottaa, kun historiastakaan ei voi ottaa oppia?

title: Ny bok: Historiska och litteraturhistoriska studier 101
content:
SLS årsbok Historiska och litteraturhistoriska studier (HLS) 101 har temat rörelse.

HLS 101 öppnar ett brett perspektiv på rörelser med texter av åtta skribenter. I ett par av bidragen behandlas arbetarrörelsen och den finlandssvenska samlingsrörelsen, medan transnationella perspektiv på rörelse öppnas i texter om Larin-Kyösti som svensk och finsk poet och den provensalska rörelsen. Andra artiklar handlar om rörelse i det konstnärliga arbetet: om taktpinnens svepande rörelser i körledarens hand och om rörelsen genom Tove Janssons manuskript. Vi får också läsa om hur ett brev av lantmätare Theodor Mollin inspirerade J.L. Runebergs skildring av Saarijärvi. I numret ingår även Kristina Malmios festtal från SLS årshögtid, om den finlandssvenska romanens kraft, och ett minnesord till Ann-Marie Ivars.

Medverkande: Robin Chouleur, Pia Forssell, Matias Kaihovirta, Christa Lundström, Juhani Niemi, Kristina Malmio, Christoffer Sundman och Sakari Ylivuori. Medverkande i minnesordet: Mona Forsskåhl, Charlotta af Hällström-Reijonen, Pirkko Nuolijärvi, Caroline Sandström, Marika Tandefelt, Camilla Wide & Jan-Ola Östman.

title: Andy Burnham keeps his options open on Brexit
content:
LIVERPOOL, England — Andy Burnham pledged to undertake the most ambitious review of Brexit since Britain left the EU.

But for now at least, he’s keeping all his options open.

Speaking at his party’s annual conference in Liverpool on Tuesday, the U.K. prime minister said the current plans to improve the Brexit settlement struck by the last Conservative government were “not enough” and that leaving the bloc had done “more harm than good.”

But Burnham didn’t pledge an immediate fix.

Instead, the newly-installed British PM said he would lay out at a summit with the EU later this year “what I believe the different options are for Britain’s long-term relationship with our European partners.”

“And there are different options,” he said. “I will see if we can find consensus around one, which will give us clarity about our position and the future of the continent that we live in.”

title: Youth Panel and Kamakura Edit-a-thon: Challenges at the 2026 Library Fair & Forum
content:
The Wikimedians of Japan User Group will exhibit “Wikimedia World 2026” at the Library Fair & Forum in October and host several events centered around its booth. Here are two of them.

First, the forum on Wednesday, October 21, will feature a panel discussion titled “University Education and Wikimedia,” where six university students, graduate students, and faculty member who are also Wikimedians will share their experiences and discuss topics related to libraries. Four of the panelists previously spoke at the ESEAP Conference in May during a session titled “Wikimedia in Education: A Look at Wiki Clubs.” This is likely the first time a public panel discussion featuring young Wikimedians has been held in Japan. Online participation is available; please register here.

Another event is the Kamakura Editathon, a Wikimedia editing event themed around Kamakura, a city neighboring Yokohama—the venue for the Library Fair. It will be held online from October 13 to November 13, with an in-person edit-a-thon taking place on October 18.

title: AI Sites Posing as News Outlets Spread to Finland
content:
Websites created and maintained entirely by artificial intelligence are becoming more common, and even the news media are not immune to this phenomenon. Over the past year, a number of websites resembling news outlets have appeared in Finland, such as UKK Uutiset and The Intelligent, whose content is entirely generated by artificial intelligence.

These sites publish content sourced from the websites of the leading daily Helsingin Sanomat, the public media service Yle and the tabloid press, as well as from social media. Occasionally, the authors are characters created by artificial intelligence who pose as journalists. On The Intelligent, AI journalists even publish opinion pieces.

Faktabaari reviewed Finnish AI news websites and found that these two sites, which react to daily current affairs, regularly highlight far-right themes. Based on social media, their reach is not extensive, but the sites may offer indications of future developments.

title: Selvitys kartoittaa pohjoismaisten taideorganisaatioiden kriisinkestävyyttä
content:
Tuore selvitys Innovative models: A report on resilience in Nordic spaces for contemporary art kartoittaa erilaisten nykytaideorganisaatioiden toimintastrategioita Ruotsissa, Suomessa ja Tanskassa.

Pohjoismaissa toimivien nykytaideorganisaatioiden toimintaa ovat leimanneet viime vuosina kasvava taloudellinen epävarmuus, poliittiset muutokset ja muuttuvat rahoitusrakenteet. Frame Contemporary Art Finlandin, Bildkonst Sverigen ja Danish Association of Art Centresin yhteistyössä käynnistämä selvitys tutkii, miten alan toimijat kehittävät ja ylläpitävät kriisinkestävyyttään muutosten keskellä.

Tuore selvitys kokoaa yhteen kokemuksia ja esimerkkejä Ruotsista, Suomesta ja Tanskasta, jotka ilmentävät, miten taideinstituutiot sopeutuvat muuttuviin olosuhteisiin ja pohtivat uudelleen yhteiskunnallista rooliaan. Hanke on syntynyt myös tarpeesta vahvistaa vapaan, osallistavan ja demokraattisen kulttuuritoiminnan pohjoismaista perinnettä.

Raportti on suunnattu ensisijaisesti nykytaiteen organisaatioille ja instituutioille, mutta se tarjoaa tietoa ja näkökulmia myös sekä poliittisilla tasoilla että yksityisissä säätiöissä päätöksiä tekeville.

title: Vieraana Ida Yli-Mäenpää: ”Tulokset näkyvät, kun tekee tarpeeksi töitä”
content:
Kun Ida Yli-Mäenpää asteli kahdeksan vuotta sitten ulos Voice of Finlandin lavalta, hän uskoi läpimurron olevan lähellä. Pian ovia aukeaisi, yhteydenottoja satelisi ja ura lähtisi vauhdilla lentoon.

Hän odotti ja odotti – mutta lopulta oikein mitään ei tapahtunutkaan.

Pettymys jätti jälkensä, ja parikymppinen artistinalku alkoi epäillä itseään. Vaikka musiikki oli kulkenut mukana koko elämän ajan, yhtäkkiä jokin pidätteli Idaa.

”Jotenkin jäädyin. Ajattelin, että ehkä musta ei olekaan tähän. Pelkäsin epäonnistumista, ja se esti mua tavoittelemasta unelmiani.”

Ida kyllä jatkoi musiikin tekemistä satunnaisesti, mutta moni asia tuntui takkuavan.   

”En vaan yksinkertaisesti tehnyt tarpeeksi töitä, että asiat olisivat edenneet. Odotin, että joku tulee hakemaan mut kotoa.”

Vuonna 2023 Ida tunsi olevansa hukassa. Hän päätti, ettei halunnut enää jäädä odottamaan omaa vuoroaan.

Syntyi suunnitelma.

Ida alkoi ahkeroida videoita TikTokiin. Niiden avulla hän kasvattaisi sosiaalisen median kanavansa niin suuriksi, että joku musiikkialalta väistämättä huomaisi hänet.

”Halusin, että mulla on valmis yleisö siinä vaiheessa, kun alan julkaista musiikkia. Päätin, että näin myös tulee tapahtumaan.”

title: Every Night Is Different: Ryley Walker on Preserving Live Music
content:
Ryley Walker says he’s flattered when people tape his live performances and post them on the Internet Archive. If he knows ahead of time, the 37-year-old singer-songwriter often puts their name on the guest list and invites them early for a sound check.

“I love when people come — either as a hobbyist or a professional — to record the show and make it available for everybody else to hear,” says Walker of his experimental/folk music. “My live shows have always been a bit dynamic with a lot of improvising. So, there’s different approaches every night to the music, and it’s cool that’s documented.”

Walker has 95 shows preserved on the Internet Archive dating back to 2017. The recordings are part of the Live Music Archive, a collection built over the past 20 years by volunteers and Internet Archive staff that now tops 300,000 recordings from more than 9,000 artists.

[See Walker’s online collection and his personal website]

“I don’t think taping the show and putting it on the internet for someone to listen to for free is like a lost sale or anything,” Walker said. “It’s been a net positive.” Indeed, the Los-Angeles based musician said the online exposure has attracted new fans.

title: Seela Sella oli lukioikäisenä kesätöissä kirjastossa
content:
Näyttelijä Seela Sella tasoittaa yhä lähikirjastossaan hyllyrivejä.

Luettiinko sinulle, kun olit lapsi?
”Luettiin paljon – mutta ei niinkään satuja, vaan runoja. Lausunta oli siihen aikaan muotia, ja jokaisessa juhlassa kuultiin aina joku lausuntanumero. Äitini oli loistava esiintyjä, ja hän lausui paljon. Minäkin olin usein mukana esiintymässä. Lausuin niitä runoja, joita äiti oli lukenut minulle. En tietenkään ymmärtänyt kaikkea, mutta äiti selitti aina, mistä runoissa oli kyse. Koetin lapsen eläytymiskyvyllä päästä mukaan tunnelmaan. Runoja oli silloin jo päässäni niin kuin nytkin.”

Millaisia ovat varhaiset kirjastomuistosi?
”Meidän kirjastossamme oli kirjastonhoitajana Annikki-niminen vanhempi rouva. Häneltä sai käydä kysymässä, mitä voisi lukea. Hän tiesi aina kaiken. Hän oli aivan ihana. Tuohon aikaan myytiin koottujen teosten kokonaisuuksia. Kirjaston palvelu oli puolestaan yksilöllistä. Siellä et ollut osa massaa, jolle myydään jotain pötkössä. Siellä mietittiin, mikä juuri sinua voisi kiinnostaa.”

title: New Norwegian online newspaper has strong ties to party with link to Russia
content:
The online media describes itself as independent, but the man behind it is a member of the FOR party, NORDIS partner Faktisk.no reports. 

Towards the end of May, a Facebook post published by Fred og Rettferdighet (FOR) leader Marielle Leraand appeared. In it, she said that a new online newspaper called “Perspektiv” had been launched in Norway and that she was impressed by the articles she had read.

Vladimir Fedorov is behind the website, and confirms that he considers himself a member of the FOR party. According to Fedorov, it is coincidental that several people on the website’s editorial team are party members.

“They are simply people who share the same views, but it has nothing to do with the party. It just means that we are moving in the same direction as them,” says Fedorov.

FOR became known to the Norwegian public ahead of the 2025 parliamentary election, when it ran an advertising campaign against Norway providing financial support for Ukraine’s defence against Russia. Norwegian billionaire Atle Berge, who has business interests in Russia, confirmed that he supported the party financially.

title: Trafigura Bought Venezuelan Gold in ‘Historic’ US Deal in March. It’s Still in Storage.
content:
Six months after the U.S. government announced it would begin gold imports from Venezuela following years of sanctions prevented the trade, the first major tranche of gold from the deal is still in storage, OCCRP has learned.

The gold is being held by commodities-trading giant Trafigura, which became the first international firm to take advantage of relaxed U.S. restrictions on purchasing Venezuelan gold in March, in what the White House touted as a “historic” deal.

"All gold Trafigura has purchased from Venezuela to-date is currently in storage, under Trafigura's control,” a Trafigura spokesperson told OCCRP in early September.

The firm declined to comment on why the gold had not been sold yet in the U.S., but experts said the hold-up could be related to supply-chain issues. Venezuelan gold is extracted from a lawless and violent region, and it may be difficult to meet U.S. requirements to show it has been produced ethically.

title: How to Explain Complicated Things
content:
You may remember a time when it was difficult to make it through the day without hearing someone cite a TED Talk. A major technological reason for that was streaming video’s new accessibility on practically everyone’s computer (especially those of people bored at work). A major cultural reason was there was a considerable demographic overlap between those who knew their way around the new video-sharing realms of the internet and those likely to want to hear a “thought leader” speak for eighteen minutes or less. Whether schools kill creativity, the mechanics of procrastination, what happens when you reply to spam e‑mail: these are just a few of the subjects that most aggressively captivated the minds of the suddenly large and chatty TED Talk audience of the late two-thousands and early twenty-tens.

Since those days, some of the most popular TED Talks ever given have undergone reputational re-evaluation. The robustness of the science undergirding Amy Cuddy’s “Your Body Language May Shape Who You Are” has been called into question, while Bill Gates’ “The Next Outbreak? We’re Not Ready,” from 2015, started to look a whole lot more prescient four or five years after it was uploaded.

title: Pedaalin matkassa Bolognaan ja Venetsiaan
content:
Torstaina pedaalilaiset aloittivat päivän tutustumalla 1560-luvulla rakennettuun Bolognan yliopiston vanhaan rakennukseen, jossa sijaitsee myös Anatominen teatteri. Osallistuimme yleiselle opastukselle, jolle olimme varanneet pääsyliput. Asiantunteva opas kuljetti meitä rakennuksen molemmissa kerroksissa, ja pääsimme kurkistamaan myös suljettujen ovien taakse. Rakennuksessa on toiminut kirjasto vuodesta 1838 lähtien.

Bolognan yliopisto on Euroopan vanhin yliopisto, ja sen historia ulottuu vuoteen 1088 saakka. Bologna on nykyäänkin vilkas yliopistokaupunki. Osa vanhasta yliopistorakennuksesta ja sen taideteoksista tuhoutui toisen maailmansodan pommituksissa. Osa taideaarteista onnistuttiin kuitenkin pelastamaan, ja erään huoneen tuhoutuneisiin freskoihin tutustuimme ennen pommituksia otettujen valokuvien avulla.

Kierrokseen kuulunut 1600-luvulla rakennettu Anatominen teatteri tuhoutui osittain pommituksissa, mutta se rakennettiin myöhemmin uudelleen. Pommituksilta säästyi esimerkiksi puisia veistoksia ja muita arvokkaita yksityiskohtia. Anatominen teatteri restauroitiin alkuperäistä ulkoasua kunnioittaen.

Osoite ja sijainti kartalla: Piazza Luigi Galvani, 1, 40124 Bologna

title: “A Massive Power Grab”: White House Proposal Threatens Funding That Helps Disabled Americans Vote
content:
Without Amy Miller, some elderly and disabled people wouldn’t be able to vote.

The attorney for Disability Rights Nebraska travels the state, investigating the quality of nursing homes and assisted living facilities. As she reminds the residents how they can report abuse or neglect, she also offers voter registration forms. Last month, she helped a veteran with a traumatic brain injury fill out change-of-address paperwork so he could vote in the upcoming midterm elections. “He 100% knew who he wanted to vote for,” Miller said, but he struggled to write with a pen.

Congress funds her organization’s efforts to ensure that even people who might not have access to the internet or transportation have the opportunity to participate in elections.

Now a White House proposal threatens that work.

title: Suomen Kulttuurirahaston apurahahaku lokakuussa
content:
Suomen Kulttuurirahaston apurahojen hakuaika lähestyy. Uudistetussa hakumenettelyssä sekä maakuntarahastojen että keskusrahaston apurahoja haetaan yhdessä valtakunnallisessa haussa. Erillistä maakuntarahastojen Tammikuun hakua ei enää jatkossa ole.

Kulttuurirahaston haussa myönnetään yhteensä 44,2 miljoonaa euroa apurahoina tieteelle, taiteelle ja kulttuurille. Summa vastaa viime vuoden hauissa yhteensä myönnettyä euromäärää. Apurahoja voi hakea valtakunnallisessa haussa 15.–30.10.2026. Hakuaika päättyy viimeisenä hakupäivänä klo 16 Suomen aikaa.

Lähikulttuuri-apurahoilla tuetaan kotiseutujen paikalliskulttuuri- ja kulttuuriperintöhankkeita. Apuraha kulki aiemmin nimellä Kotiseututyö, ja se oli haettavana maakuntarahastojen Tammikuun haussa.

Apurahaa voi hakea tieteelliseen tai taiteelliseen työskentelyyn sekä hankkeisiin ja hankintoihin. Hakea voivat suomalaiset tai Suomessa asuvat tai toimivat henkilöt ja yhteisöt. Hakea voi myös, jos hakemuksella on selkeä, vahva yhteys Suomeen tai suomalaiseen kulttuuriin.

title: Are Libraries Prepared for the Second Digital Transformation of Distinctive Collections?
content:
Academic and research libraries, as well as public libraries, historical societies, and other organizations, hold extensive collections of rare and unique materials, such as archival and manuscript collections. These materials form an essential part of humanity’s cultural and historical record, and they are the vital source material for many humanistic fields. I believe that a second digital transformation is at hand for distinctive collections. How can library leaders establish a strategy for their distinctive collections that is fit for purpose today?

title: Lapsi- ja nuorisolähtöinen sosiaalityö -teos kuvaa lasten ja nuorten kokemuksia ja painottaa kohtaamisen merkitystä
content:
Anu-Riina Svenlinin, Tiina Lehto-Lundénin ja Tuuli Lamposen toimittama Lapsi- ja nuorisolähtöinen sosiaalityö kokoaa yhteen ajankohtaista tutkimusta ja kokemustietoa 2020-luvun Suomesta. Teos päästää ääneen myös lapset ja nuoret ja kuvaa heidän kokemuksiaan koulumaailmassa ja lastensuojelun asiakkaina.

Lapsi- ja nuorisolähtöisyys on lapsi- ja perhesosiaalityön ja lastensuojelun eettinen ja ammatillinen ydin. Lapsi- ja nuorisolähtöisen sosiaalityön tehtävänä on vastata lasten ja nuorten toiveeseen ja tarpeeseen tulla kohdatuksi.

Uutuuskirja Lapsi- ja nuorisolähtöinen sosiaalityö kuvaa lasten ja nuorten kokemuksia erilaisissa arjen ympäristöissä, erityisesti koulumaailmassa ja asiakkaina lastensuojelun avohuollossa, sijaishuollossa ja jälkihuollossa. Samalla pureudutaan kehitystiedon, sukupuolisensitiivisyyden ja antirasistisen työskentelyn teoreettisiin lähtökohtiin ja merkitykseen käytännön työssä.

title: UN warns of ‘narrowing window’ to restore world’s forests
content:
Food and Agriculture Organization urges governments to make forest restoration a national priority

The world faces a “narrowing window” to restore forests essential for food security and resistance to the climate emergency, a United Nations report has warned.

More than 489m hectares (1.2bn acres) of forests have been cleared since 1990, while an even greater area is degraded, the world body said in a call for governments to make forest restoration a national priority.

Oulun yliopisto perustaa uuden tieteidenvälisen instituutin, jonka tarkoituksena on vahvistaa eri tieteenalojen sekä tutkimuksen ja muun yhteiskunnan välistä yhteistyötä.

Integra-niminen instituutti kokoaa yhteen tutkijoita, opiskelijoita ja yhteiskunnan eri toimijoita kehittämään uusia tapoja tarkastella ja ratkaista monimutkaisia yhteiskunnallisia haasteita.

"Aikamme merkittävimmät haasteet eivät noudata tieteenalojen rajoja. Siksi myöskään ratkaisut eivät synny yksittäisen tieteenalan sisältä. Tieteidenvälinen yhteistyö on välttämättömyys, jos haluamme löytää uusia ja vaikuttavia ratkaisuja yhteiskunnan suuriin kysymyksiin", tutkimuksesta vastaava vararehtori Matti Latva-aho sanoo Oulun yliopiston tiedotteessa.

Instituutin tavoitteena on tuoda yhteen eri tieteenalojen osaamista sekä yliopiston ulkopuolisia toimijoita. Tarkoituksena on kehittää ja testata uusia ideoita, menetelmiä ja ratkaisuja sekä edistää niiden käyttöönottoa.

Samalla yliopisto pyrkii synnyttämään tutkimushankkeita, jotka ylittävät perinteisiä tieteenala- ja organisaatiorajoja. Tutkimuksella halutaan tuottaa tietoa muun muassa kestävän hyvinvoinnin, kilpailukyvyn ja yhteiskunnan uudistumiskyvyn tueksi.

title: Two New Birds Louder Than Jackhammers Just Dropped
content:
Scientists have identified two new contenders for the world’s loudest bird—the bare-throated bellbird and the red-legged seriema—both of which can exceed 120 decibels, which is louder than a jackhammer, according to a study published on Tuesday in Evolution. 

These two bird species are now in the same league as the white bellbird, which shattered the record for loudest bird in 2019 after its bizarre call was first measured and reported by Jeff Podos, a professor in the department of biology at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. It’s worth taking a moment to listen to the bellbird’s otherworldly call, which the males unleash over their remote habitat in the northern Amazon rainforest.

In the new study, Podos and former UMass Amherst graduate student João C.T. Menezes report that the bare-throated bellbird and the red-legged seriema occupy the same decibel range as the white bellbird. It's tough to declare a clear winner among the three birds due to differences in measurement techniques and individual variations within each species.

title: The AI Financial Fault Line — Does China Enjoy an Edge?
content:
The US depends on private financing. Chipmakers and other tech leaders are leveraging their booming profits to invest in, guarantee, and otherwise finance customers. The Economist has even labeled NVIDIA the “central bank of AI.”

China uses a different model: state-led funds, state-run bank financing, local government investment vehicles, subsidized compute, and state coordination. 

Although the US private financing approach works well at the start of a capital-intensive build-out, it may come under stress during a downturn. If AI demand disappoints, chip prices fall faster than expected, or AI applications take longer to produce paying customers, the pain could spread fast and wide, hitting equipment sales, data center revenues, customer creditworthiness, and the value of the supplier’s equity stake.

China suffers its own debt and overcapacity risks. State-directed funds can create duplication and poor allocation; local governments already carry high debt burdens; and state banks may roll over weak projects rather than force rapid restructuring.

title: While the Country Rejects ALPR Mass Surveillance, SF Settles for Weak Safeguards
content:
San Francisco's decision to retain its use of Automated License Plate Reader (ALPR) surveillance cameras belies what we know about this spying technology tool: it endangers residents and threatens the privacy and civil liberties of our community. Based on what's in the city's press release and announcement, this policy will do nothing to stop actual harms.

We know innocent drivers will be stopped and menaced by officers because of erroneous matches. We know officers use Flock to stalk potential and past romantic partners. Data will be accessed by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and used to deport immigrants. Promising greater penalties for such abuse will not end this. These are not isolated mistakes that another policy can fix. They are consequences of building a system that records everyone’s movements and makes them searchable by police. This is also not unique to a single vendor. From Flock Safety to Motorola to Axon—San Francisco must end its use of ALPRs.

title: How World Trade Organization reform could help address the EU-China trade imbalance
content:
The world was closely watching the high-stakes US-China summit in Washington from September 23 – 25, which resulted in the US and China agreeing, among other things, to extend their trade truce by two months. Now, the spotlight has shifted to Beijing, as the EU and China enter the final stretch ahead of a decisive round of trade talks seeking to remedy export/import imbalances. On October 8 and 9, trade negotiators from both sides will gather in Beijing for the second meeting of the newly established EU-China Trade and Investment Consultations Mechanism (TIC).

The TIC was launched in June this year, marking a significant step for both sides in restoring an institutional channel for dialogue on trade and investment after a period of relatively limited engagement. The forthcoming meeting is therefore more than a routine round of talks. It will be the first real test facing the new TIC: whether it is useful in stabilising EU-China relations and pulling the two back from the brink of a looming trade war. It is far too early to tell. What is already clear, however, is that some of the most difficult and pressing issues are on the negotiating table.

title: Afghans "Have Been the Victims" of U.S. Military, Taliban, Cartels & More for Decades: Nagieb Khaja
content:
Award-winning Danish Afghan journalist and filmmaker Nagieb Khaja’s most recent documentary, Winning Heart and Minds, is an investigation into what went wrong in the U.S.-led war in Afghanistan. In the film, Khaja travels to Musa Qala, the capital of the southern Helmand province. Danish and British troops had been deployed to Musa Qala in 2006 to defend their allies, the local police, against Taliban insurgents.

While urban areas benefited from U.S. occupation during the war, “Western forces allied themselves with forces that in rural Afghanistan were considered worse than the Taliban,” says Khaja. “The police forces and the warlords that were fighting side by side with American, Danish and British forces, they were drug cartels, they were ruthless criminals, they were rapists.”

title: Oletko julkishallinnon asiantuntija? Luo kansainvälisiä kontakteja ja jaa osaamistasi EU:n TAIEX-yhteistyöllä
content:
Oletko kiinnostunut kansainvälisestä yhteistyöstä? Haluatko jakaa oman alasi parhaita käytäntöjä ja suomalaista osaamista maailmalla? Liity TAIEX-asiantuntijarekisteriin!

Euroopan komission lyhytkestoisen teknisen tuen ohjelma TAIEX tarjoaa suomalaisille julkisen hallinnon asiantuntijoille mahdollisuuden jakaa osaamista, oppia uutta ja luoda arvokkaita kansainvälisiä kontakteja.

Lyhytkestoiset asiantuntijatehtävät edistävät hyvää hallintoa EU:n kumppanimaissa, vahvistavat Suomen roolia kansainvälisenä toimijana ja tukevat virkahenkilöiden ammatillista kehitystä.

TAIEX-toiminnasta 60 prosenttia toteutetaan EU:n laajentumis- ja naapuruuspolitiikan alueilla, mutta yhteistyötä tehdään miltei kaikkialla maailmassa.

TAIEXin kautta rahoitettavien tapahtumien kesto on yleensä 2–5 päivää, ja niiden sisältö suunnitellaan yhteistyössä edunsaajamaan ja komission kanssa. Komissio rahoittaa esimerkiksi työpajoja, räätälöityjä koulutuksia edunsaajamaassa sekä kumppanimaiden asiantuntijoiden opintomatkoja EU-maihin.

title: Tasavallan presidentti Alexander Stubbin puhe Luxemburgin valtiovierailun juhlapäivällisellä Suurherttuan palatsissa 29. syyskuuta 2026
content:
Puheen alkuperäinen kieli on englanti.

Muutosvarauksin

Teidän kuninkaalliset korkeutenne,
arvoisat ministerit,
arvoisat suurlähettiläät,
hyvät naiset ja herrat,
hyvät ystävät.

Tänne on aina yhtä hyvä palata. Aivan kuin tulisi kotiin.

Haluan aloittaa yksinkertaisella havainnolla: Suomi ja Luxemburg ovat ehkä pieniä maita, mutta emme ole koskaan ajatelleet pienesti. Historiamme, taloutemme ja asemamme Euroopassa osoittavat, että kun maailma muuttuu, me mukaudumme nopeasti ja tartumme avautuviin mahdollisuuksiin.

Tänään haluaisin puhua kolmesta meitä yhdistävästä asiasta: ensinnäkin kyvystämme muuntautua; toiseksi, siitä miten olemme sitoutuneet Eurooppaan ja monenkeskiseen yhteistyöhön; ja kolmanneksi, ihmisten välisistä siteistä, jotka yhdistävät maitamme.

Aloitetaan muuntautumiskyvystämme.

Suomella ja Luxemburgilla on epätavallinen historiallinen yhteys: Luxemburg on suurherttuakunta ja Suomi oli aikoinaan suuriruhtinaskunta. Luxemburg on säilyttänyt valtiomuotonsa, kun taas Suomi valitsi eri tien, ja meistä tuli tasavalta.

title: Ethiopia is sliding back toward war – a look at what is driving the fighting and why it matters
content:
Four years after a fragile ceasefire ended widespread conflict in Ethiopia, the region is again slipping back into full-out war.

On Sept. 23, 2026, advancing soldiers of the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) seized government positions in northern Ethiopia.

It followed the announcement of a new alliance of seven armed movements in opposition to the Ethiopian government and deteriorating relations between the country and neighboring Eritrea, which it accuses of supporting the new alliance.

As an expert on conflict in the Horn of Africa and Ethiopian national security, I know the spiraling conditions now have been long in the making. The November 2022 Pretoria Cessation of Hostilities Agreement ended immediate fighting between Ethiopia and Tigrayan rebels, but it did not constitute a comprehensive peace settlement. Crucially, it was never followed by wider political negotiations to address the root causes of the war. The concern now is that the conflicts will intersect with the civil war in neighboring Sudan, causing a complicated, regionwide conflagration.
snippet: Four years after a fragile ceasefire ended widespread conflict in Ethiopia, the region is again slipping back into full-out war.

title: Päätoimittajalta: Daavidin ja muiden paskiaisten lingot
content:
Raamatun hahmoista linkomies, myöhempi kuningas Daavid on modernin ristiriitainen persoona.

Nuorena paimenena hän onnistui vastoin odotuksia kaatamaan filistealaisen Goljat-soturin, ja pääsi tällä realitykisan voitolla julkkikseksi.

Kuninkaana häntä voisi myös kuvata kunniattomaksi paskiaiseksi: Daavid tapatti salarakkaansa aviomiehen, salli nepolapsiensa tehdä julmuuksia eikä antanut armoa voitetuilleen.

Vanhan testamentin Samuelin kirjan mukaan Daavid tuhosi valloittamiaan alueita viimeiseen mieheen ja naiseen asti, ja jopa syyttömät ammonilaiset hän siirsi raakaan pakkotyöhön.

Vallan, verenhimon ja voitonriemun sokaisema Daavid nöyrtyi silti vanhemmiten katumaan tekojaan, ja hyväksyi Jahven tuomion.

Ajoituksesta riippuu, missä vaiheessa Daavidin kanssa asioidessa vastassa oli etninen puhdistaja ja missä taas armollisuuden löytänyt, kansaa yhdistänyt valtiomies.

KAHDEN samanaikaisen todellisuuden arki näkyy nykyisessä Israelissa.

Pääministeri Benjamin Netanjahu on paitsi talousrikollinen, myös Gazan järkyttävästä tuhoamisesta tuomiolle joutava sotarikosepäilty.

title: Lamaa ja hanaa ynnä muuta armotonta menoa ysärillä
content:
”Armotonta menoa”, lauloi talonmies Sepi Kumpulainen vuonna 1991. Sinnikästä eteenpäinpuskemista kuvaavaa laulua on jälkeenpäin pidetty ysärin eli yhdeksänkymmentäluvun ilmapiirin symbolina.

Vuosikymmentä leimaavat monenlaiset murrokset ja myllerrykset niin Suomessa kuin maailmallakin. Lama, kriisit ja sodat tulevat lähelle; toisaalta riemuitaan Nokiasta, maailmanmestaruuksista ja millenniumista.

1990-luku on sanastoltaan hyvin rikas. Esimerkiksi tieto- ja ympäristö-sanasto kukoistavat. Vuonna 1997 ilmestyneessä Suomen kielen perussanakirjassa on ympäristö-alkuisten sanojen ryhmässä 32 uudissanaa, esimerkiksi ympäristöaktiivi, ympäristöpakolainen ja ympäristörikos. Tieto-alkuisia uudissanoja sanakirjassa on peräti 76, esimerkiksi tiedonhaku, tietojärjestelmä, tietokonevirus, tietotyö, tietovuoto ja tietoyhteiskunta.

title: EU to Trump: We will keep pushing for global AI safety rules
content:
The European Commission will continue to seek an international agreement on AI security, despite U.S. resistance, EU tech chief Henna Virkkunen said Tuesday.

“The U.S. has been very public saying they don’t want to have international regulation … because they have concerns that it’s hindering innovation,” Virkkunen said on the stage of the RAID Conference in Brussels in response to questions by POLITICO.

U.S. President Donald Trump has brushed away concerns about AI existential risks as a “hoax,” and declared his opposition to global regulations. The EU takes a different view, having offered its support for last week’s initiative for an international safety body to monitor AI led by Finland and Norway, and signed by 20 other countries.

“We have a different approach because we think that, if you are regulating in a pro-innovation manner, it’s also a good basis for innovation that people have trust in those technologies,” said Virkkunen, the EU Commissioner responsible for technology.

She praised the EU’s landmark 2024 AI Act as a strong regulatory basis for tackling challenges posed by AI bots.
snippet: The European Commission will continue to seek an international agreement on AI security, despite U.S. resistance, EU tech chief Henna Virkkunen said Tuesday.

title: Holding community events during the war – insights from Ukraine
content:
At the annual Wikimedia CEE Meeting, I presented a talk on how Wikimedia Ukraine holds community events during the war. This post is a writeup of key points:

For context, Russia’s war against Ukraine started in 2014 but entered its all-out stage in February 2022, with martial law, regular Russian strikes against civilian infrastructure, etc. The full-scale invasion is still going on, with no clear end in sight.

Wikimedia Ukraine has continued operating, growing, and, among other work, holding community events throughout this time.We hold one flagship annual conference with 100+ people, usually in the fall, as well as 3–4 other large offline or hybrid events per year, such as conferences for educators and researchers.

We also organize dozens of small online events and occasional small offline events, like editathons.

Events face three key wartime problems: 

  • The first problem is direct security threats – as in, a Russian drone might literally hit the location of our conference.
  • The second is power outages. They do not happen all the time: Russian attacks on energy infrastructure are seasonal, usually timed before the winter, for maximum destructive impact.

title: Whistleblower protection in Romania: A legal framework still struggling in practice
content:
The law protects whistleblowers from retaliation, allows them to report wrongdoing through internal and external channels, and designates the National Integrity Agency (ANI) as the central authority for external reporting. Yet the number of reports remains low, with significant differences between institutions.

The main challenge is no longer the absence of a legal framework, but the gap between the protections established by law and how the system actually works in practice, according to several comparative studies and analyses.

Romania had a whistleblower protection mechanism as early as 2004. But it applied only to public-sector employees and did not provide official reporting channels or protection mechanisms considered adequate.

A major overhaul came in 2022 with the adoption of Law No. 361/2022 on the protection of whistleblowers in the public interest. The new legislation established a more comprehensive reporting system and made the National Integrity Agency (ANI) the main authority responsible for external reports.

title: When the right to protest remains, but demonstrating comes at a price
content:
Climate activists are particularly vulnerable to arrest and persecution

Originally published on Global Voices

A climate protest in Copenhagen. Image from Flickr. CC BY-NC-ND 2.0.

This post is part of Global Voices’ September 2026 Spotlight series, “Protest in Democracy.” With this Spotlight, we seek to explore the many forms of protest, the tactics states use to delegitimize and suppress them, and the complex relationship between protest and democracy. You can support this coverage by donating here.

Across Europe, governments are using criminal laws against climate and environmental protesters — a phenomenon that shows few signs of retreating. A comparative study published in late 2025, examining 14 countries across the Global North and South, found that criminalization forms part of a wider pattern of repression. Researchers identified not only arrests, but new anti-protest laws, the strategic use of existing laws and legal processes, surveillance, harassment, and the public vilification of activists.

title: Three Baha’i Citizens Sentenced to 35 Years in Prison, Additional Punishments, and Property Confiscation
content:
According to HRANA, Baha’i citizens Hengameh Sharifinia, Fouad Abdolghaffari, and Fahim Agahi have been sentenced to prison and additional punishments.

The ruling was issued in late September by Branch 15 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court, presided over by Judge Abolghasem Salavati. Under the ruling, Ms. Sharifinia was sentenced to 10 years in prison and 10 years of deprivation of social rights on the charge of “deviant educational or proselytizing activities contrary to or disruptive of the sacred law of Islam,” under Article 500 bis of the Islamic Penal Code. She was also sentenced to five years in prison on the charge of “membership in groups and organizations aimed at disrupting national security,” under Article 499 of the Islamic Penal Code.

title: Iraqi Lawmaker Sentenced to 7 Years, Fined $21 Million for Illicit Enrichment
content:
An Iraqi court has sentenced sitting lawmaker Mohammed Farman Shaher to seven years in prison for illicit enrichment, ordering him to pay the equivalent of over $21.4 million in restitution and fines, according to legal authorities.

Shaher was ordered to repay 11.8 billion Iraqi dinars ($9.01 million) and $1.73 million in illicit gains, alongside an equivalent fine.

Shaher, who was arrested on June 28, serves on parliament’s Oil and Gas Committee. He is a member of the Sunni Taqaddum Party, led by former parliament speaker Mohammed al-Halbousi and home to current speaker Haibat al-Halbousi.

title: Mick Jagger Tells the Story Behind ‘Gimme Shelter’ and Merry Clayton’s Haunting Background Vocals
content: In the fall of 1969 the Rolling Stones were in a Los Angeles recording studio, putting the final touches on their album Let It Bleed. It was a tumultuous time for the Stones. They had been struggling with the album for the better part of a year as they dealt with the personal disintegration of their founder and multi-instrumentalist Brian Jones, whose drug addiction and personality problems had reached a critical stage. Jones was fired from the band in June of that year. He died less than a month later. And although the Stones couldn’t have known it at the time, the year would end on another catastrophic note, as violence broke out at the notorious Altamont Free Concert just a day after Let It Bleed was released.

title: Learnings from the Urban Mushroom Upcycling Operations pilot
content:
At first, a brewery and a mushroom farm might not seem to have much in common. One produces beer. The other grows fungi.

But in Viikki, University of Helsinki students tested what happens when the two are connected and when the mycelia – i.e. the mushroom spawn – becomes part of an even bigger loop.

From May to September 2026, a group of University of Helsinki students calling themselves the Shroomhead crew (Milla Tammivuori, Volter Kaitila, Silver De Vries, Sanni Taba and Amanda Tikkanen) took part in the Urban Mushroom Upcycling Operations Pilot, an experiment in local food production, circular bioeconomy and urban upcycling.

Coordinated by the Viikki Food Design Factory, this pilot brought together students, university researchers and local companies, Helsieni and CoolHead Brew. Together, they explored whether mushroom cultivation, food production and material experimentation could be interconnected into a local, urban circular operation.

The idea is simple. Grow mushrooms locally. Eat them locally. Then ask what can be done with what is left.

title: Vihreät nuoret esittää Suomeen päihdehoitotuomioistuinta
content:
Vihreät nuoret esittää Suomeen päihdehoitotuomioistuinta ihmisille, joiden rikoskierteen taustalla on päihderiippuvuus.

Ehdotusta perustellaan päihdeongelmien ja rikosten uusimisen vahvalla yhteydellä. Järjestön tiedotteen mukaan 87 prosentilla Suomen vangeista on todettu elinaikainen päihteiden käyttöhäiriö. Useamman kerran vankilassa olleista päihdehäiriö on todettu 91 prosentilla. Lisäksi noin puolet käräjäoikeudessa tuomituista henkilöistä on rikoksenuusijoita.

"Olisi aika kysyä, puutummeko uusintarikollisuudessa syyhyn vai vain sen oireisiin. Päihderiippuvuus ratkaistaan hoidolla ja avulla, ei vankilalla", Vihreiden nuorten puheenjohtaja Maria Saita kommentoi tiedotteessa.

"Mitä jos rikoskierteen taustalla oleva riippuvuus hoidettaisiin ennen rankaisemista?" Saita kysyy.

Esitetty päihdehoitotuomioistuin perustuisi kansainväliseen Alcohol and Other Drug Treatment Court -malliin. Rikoksesta syylliseksi todettu henkilö voisi ennen rangaistuksen määräämistä hakeutua vapaaehtoisesti intensiiviseen hoito- ja kuntoutusohjelmaan. Ohjelman onnistunut suorittaminen voisi johtaa lievempään rangaistukseen.

title: Surveillance Finds a Way
content:
A thing I’ve been saying over and over is that surveillance companies can’t be trusted to regulate themselves or to make privacy decisions themselves, because one company’s red line is another company’s business opportunity. Today we’re investigating a company that saw Flock was not offering facial recognition and saw a challenge.

Also: Some dudes are letting ChatGPT drive a car in a parking lot in San Francisco, a data center company promises to cut people big checks if their data center gets approved, and the Muse backlash has begun. Welcome back to our new experiment with daily newsletters. If you like this, subscribe here. -Jason

As Flock continues to be the center of a nationwide conversation about automatic license plate reading cameras, the company has said that it doesn’t, and won’t, do facial recognition: “We will not add facial recognition to our devices,” Flock CEO Garrett Langley said in a recent video. But other, third-party companies are telling cops that they are willing to add facial recognition to data gathered by Flock cameras in order to “close that gap.”

title: Privacy’s Defenders Podcast: Cowboys, Cypherpunks and Visionaries
content:
People are increasingly concerned about the ways in which mass surveillance is tracking our every move: from Flock license plate readers to face recognition to creepy ads that – based on what we see and do online – seem to know everything we’re thinking and planning. It didn’t have to be this way, and since the early days of the internet, a dedicated band of activists, lawyers and technologists have fought for a better, more secure and private digital future – a future that’s still attainable.  

Cindy Cohn, who just finished a 26-year run with the Electronic Frontier Foundation including 11 years as its executive director, has lived this fight. She says privacy isn’t just about secrecy: It's ultimately about power – who has it, and who has the ability to protect themselves from it.   

Welcome to the first episode of “Privacy’s Defenders,” a podcast about the people – lawyers, journalists, hackers, and others – who’ve fought to secure your digital liberties since before most people even knew what the internet was.

(You can also find this episode on the Internet Archive and on YouTube.)

title: "Buying More Time for the Genocide": Muhammad Shehada on Trump's Gaza Plan 1 Year Later
content:
The Palestinian death toll from Israel’s war on Gaza has surpassed 74,000, according to the Ministry of Health in Gaza. While this figure represents the official death toll as confirmed by local authorities, the true number could be much higher when missing people and indirect deaths are taken into account, such as from disease, exposure, denial of medical treatment and the destruction of civic infrastructure. And since the so-called ceasefire brokered by Trump last October, nearly 1,400 Palestinians have been killed in Israeli attacks.

“The [ceasefire] plan ended up just buying more time for the genocide,” says Muhammad Shehada, a writer and analyst from Gaza speaking to Democracy Now! in Copenhagen. “Instead of suspending attacks on Gaza, Israel has been bombing Gaza every day.”

“The idea of the plan was to divide the reconstruction, rehabilitation, Israeli withdrawal, decommissioning of Hamas and Palestinian statehood into three phases,” says Shehada. “So far, only one item of the 20 items on the Trump plan has been fulfilled, and that is the release of every single Israeli hostage in Gaza.”

title: Why monkeys handle conflicts better than we do
content:
Léa suggests postponing the launch by a week. The data speaks for itself, and the recommendation seems reasonable. However, at the last team meeting, Marc had defended sticking to the original date. Agreeing to the change now would mean admitting he was wrong. The issue gets resolved when management decides to side with Léa, but Marc feels rejected as a result, and his working relationship with Léa suffers.

Conflicts with our colleagues, loved ones or team members can quickly stifle communication, heighten tensions and undermine relationships. However, a decision or compromise is not always enough to restore co-operation — for a solution to last, we must also repair the bond that will allow people to continue moving forward together.

Primates offer us a useful mirror here. Among them, the repair of that bond generally appears more direct — they re-establish contact, soothe one another and restore their relationships in the process.

Studies in primatology have documented these reconciliation behaviours and demonstrated their great importance: in species that depend heavily on co-operation for survival, maintaining group cohesion is vital.

title: Suomi pyytää EU:lta viimeisiä elpymisrahojaan
content:
Suomi on lähettänyt Euroopan komission arvioitavaksi kuudennen ja viimeisen maksupyynnön, joka liittyy EU:n elpymis- ja palautumistukivälineeseen, kertoi valtiovarainministeriö tiistaina.

Ehtona maksulle on, että komissio katsoo Suomen saavuttaneen sille asetetut tavoitteet. Suomen mielestä näin on tapahtunut.

Komissio julkistaa arvion Suomen suoriutumisesta 20. marraskuuta mennessä.

MAKSUPYYNNÖN perusteena on 26 välitavoitetta, jotka liittyvät muun muassa energiainfrastruktuurin investointeihin, vihreän ja digitaalisen siirtymän edistämiseen ja liikenteen vähähiilisiin ratkaisuihin.

title: Hanna Bergholmin palkittu ja kansainvälisesti menestynyt YÖN LAPSI voitti Pohjoismaiden parhaan elokuvan pääpalkinnon The Freyas -gaalassa - elokuvateattereissa 6.11.
content:
Yön lapsen festivaali- ja palkintomenestys alkoi viime helmikuussa, kun se pääsi ainoaisena pohjoismaisena pitkänä elokuvana Berlinalen elokuvajuhlien pääkilpasarjaan, ja keräsi erinomaisia arvioita kansainvälisiltä kriitikoilta alan tärkeimmissä medioissa, mm. Hollywood Reporterissa, Varietyssä ja Screen Dailyssä. Elokuva on saanut Rotten Tomatoes-sivustolla Certified Fresh-merkinnän tarkoittaen, että valtaosa arvosteluista on positiivisia.

Huhtikuussa elokuva palkittiin Brysselissä Silver Mélies -palkinnolla ja se on ehdolla Euroopan parhaaksi genre-elokuvaksi. Heinäkuussa Yön lapsi palkittiin Amerikan merkittävimmällä genre-elokuvafestivaalilla Fantasia Film Festivalilla parhaan elokuvan palkinnolla, ja näyttelijä Seidi Haarla parhaana näyttelijänä.

Tuorein palkinto elokuvalle myönnettiin viime viikolla ensimmäistä kertaa järjestetyssä pohjoismaisessa elokuva- ja tv-alan The Freyas -gaalassa, jossa Yön lapsi palkittiin parhaana pohjoismaisena elokuvana.

Lokakuussa ensi-iltahumua Lontoossa

Yön lapsi sai viime viikolla Suomen ensiesityksensä R&A-festivaalin kotimaisena gaalaelokuvana. Lokakuussa on vuorossa Iso-Britannian merkittävin elokuvafestivaali BFI London Film Festival. Lontoossa punaisella matolla nähdään ohjaaja Hanna Bergholmin lisäksi myös elokuvan toinen päänäyttelijä Rupert Grint sekä elokuvan englantilaisen työryhmän edustajia, jotka ovat ansioituneet muun muassa Star Wars, Alien, Jurassic World ja Dark Knight -elokuvissa.

Elokuvan kansainvälinen menestys ei ole jäänyt huomiotta, sillä sille on vastikään myönnetty yhteensä lähes 700 000 euroa EU:n Luova Eurooppa -ohjelman arvostettua Films on the Move -levitystukea.

Suomessa Yön lapsi tulee elokuvateattereihin Halloween-ennakkonäytöksinä, ja laajalti kautta maan 6.11. SF Studiosin levittämänä.

title: ‘Do better for Australia’: OpenAI apologizes for unauthorized access
content:
CANBERRA — OpenAI has apologized to Australia for unauthorized access to Medicare statistical data by its agents and its handling of the incident, promising to do better and rebuild trust with the Australian public.

OpenAI broke its silence about the June incident, which it described as artificial intelligence models accessing Australian government websites “in ways they were not authorized to do” during internal training and evaluation.

“We are sorry and working to do better in the future,” OpenAI said in a statement.

“This is a new kind of cyber incident which represents an emerging global challenge. One of the ways we intend to take accountability for the situation is to be intentional in working with Australia to help develop practical approaches to how AI developers and governments identify, disclose, and respond to AI cyber behavior, whether malicious or unintentional.”

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese responded to the apology Tuesday, saying he had a “direct but constructive discussion” with OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman. “OpenAI have been very constructive and open … and I welcome that.”

title: RFK Jr outlines expansive vision for collecting US health data at Maha event
content:
Health secretary calls for medical and lifestyle details to be sent to doctors and AI to address ‘chronic disease epidemic’

Robert F Kennedy Jr laid out an expansive vision for collecting, sharing and analyzing US health information at a Maha event hosted by a close ally and outspoken anti-vaccine activist.

Medical and lifestyle data, from doctor’s visits to exercise, should be connected and shared with the government and independent researchers, where it can be searched by AI – including potential links between vaccines and health outcomes including autism and mortality, suggested Kennedy, the secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and a longtime vaccine skeptic.

content: Herschal Jackson is going through the request-for-adminship process on four South African language Wikipedias. He doesn’t speak any of them. It’s a rough measure of how dire the situation is, he says: many of South Africa’s local-language wikis have no administrators, no technical contributors, and no one in the community advocating for them consistently. title: EU migration policy tightens. Frontex and return hubs take centre stage
content:
The Munich Migration Meeting was originally conceived as a gathering of Germany and its neighbouring countries. German Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt said the meeting had since become “a genuine platform for discussing migration”, with participants agreeing that “we want to push forward the shift in migration policy”.

Magnus Brunner, the European Commissioner for Internal Affairs and Migration, highlighted what he described as clear progress: “Irregular migration has fallen by 55 per cent over the past two years, and by more than another third this year.” In his view, this shows that Europe has managed to “put its house in order” through a series of reforms.

“This is the result of a consistent policy over the past two years, and the new rules have yet to reach their full effect,” the Commissioner said. He pointed to Germany as a country playing a leading role. “Europe needs a strong Germany,” he added, particularly in the fight against irregular migration.

title: Seven Arrested in Massive EU Fraud Scheme Selling Used Phones as New
content:
An international law enforcement operation led by the European Public Prosecutor’s Office (EPPO) resulted in the arrests of seven people, including two alleged ringleaders, to dismantle a criminal network suspected of selling more than one million used mobile phones as new, the EPPO announced Tuesday. The cross-border crackdown, code-named "Troja," involved more than 1,700 officers conducting over 160 searches across 19 countries. Authorities estimate the scheme defrauded European Union consumers of at least 300 million euros ($340 million) and caused 30 million euros ($34 million) in value-added tax (VAT) losses.

According to prosecutors, the syndicate assembled phones from used components in Hong Kong and the United Arab Emirates. The devices were then shipped through the Netherlands to warehouses in Germany, where they were cleaned, packaged, and sold on online marketplaces to unsuspecting customers across the EU as brand-new products.

title: Call for talks and posters: HELDIG Summit 2026 Methodological encounters
content:
We are gathering speakers and poster proposals for the next HELDIG Summit that aims to provide a snapshot of digital research in SSH today. To bring about discussion, we are planning three themes: digital history, digital social sciences and digital heritage. The Summit is a good opportunity to give visibility to your latest research and tools, get inspired by methodological innovations in similar fields, and make new connections. 

The HELDIG Summit brings together social sciences and humanities in a day that takes a snapshot at the state of the art in digital research. This year, we bring discussion around methodological and infrastructure encounters beyond disciplines. What challenges in data processing new methods enable us to overcome? How to maintain and adapt our research tools to fast-changing technological landscape? How to target the use of AI responsibly in the research cycle?

title: Surveillance Company Tells Cops It Wants to Add Facial Recognition to Flock Cameras
content:
As Flock continues to be the center of a nationwide conversation about automatic license plate reading cameras, the company has said that it doesn’t, and won’t, do facial recognition: “We will not add facial recognition to our devices,” Flock CEO Garrett Langley said in a recent video. But other, third-party companies are telling cops that they are willing to add facial recognition to data gathered by Flock cameras in order to “close that gap.” 

A company called VIDIZMO is advertising the capability to export footage from FlockOS to its own platforms that do facial recognition, behavior prediction, and racial and gender analysis on live camera feeds. VIDIZMO is a several decades-old video analysis and database company that has started offering facial recognition technology to cops within the last six months. In a May email to Johnson City, Tennessee, deputy police chief Michael Adams, a salesperson from VIDIZMO wrote that the company’s product could do facial recognition on both Flock and Axon data in “one searchable platform.”

title: Greenland Deal: Trump Drops Threat to Annex Denmark Territory in Favor of Greater U.S. Military Role
content:
After months of threatening to take over Greenland by force, President Trump last week signed a 10-page agreement with Greenland and Denmark that bolsters the U.S. military presence on the mineral-rich and strategically located island but falls short of his earlier demands to make it American territory. Under the 1951 Defense of Greenland Treaty, the United States already has wide latitude to station forces and build military bases in Greenland. The U.S. currently has one active military base and around 160 troops on the ground. Under the new agreement, signed shortly after President Trump’s speech to the United Nations General Assembly last week, the U.S. can build two new bases. The deal keeps Greenland as part of Denmark and would still apply if Greenland chooses independence.

“In many ways, the deal is good, because the right for self-determination is approved,” says Julie Rademacher, chair of Uagut, the national organization for Greenlanders in Denmark. At the same time, “after threats [for] one-and-a-half years to annex Greenland, we don’t have the same faith or the same trust in Americans and the U.S. president.”

title: How can the same El Niño cause drought in one part of the world and floods in another?
content:
The Pacific Ocean is warming unusually quickly, and this year’s El Niño has already surpassed previous records. Forecasters expect it to strengthen even further before approaching its usual peak around December.

El Niño, the warm phase of a natural fluctuation in the Earth’s climate system, can reshape weather thousands of miles away, bringing drought to some regions while increasing the risk of heavy rain and flooding in others. To understand why, you need to follow what happens to the Pacific’s warm water – and the air above it.

Usually, winds over the tropical Pacific blow from east to west, pushing warm surface water towards the western Pacific, where it piles up around Indonesia and nearby regions. These are the trade winds. As warm water moves westward, colder water from deeper in the ocean rises to replace it in the east — a process called upwelling. This is why the western Pacific is usually much warmer than the eastern Pacific.

title: Valiokunta: Taloyhtiö saisi määrätä tupakointikieltoja ominpäin
content:
Eduskunnan perustuslakivaliokunnan mielestä taloyhtiö voisi itse päättää tupakoinnin kieltämisestä ilman perustuslaillisia esteitä.

Valiokunta joutui tupakkalain uudistamisen yhteydessä ottamaan nyt kantaa siihen, pitääkö kiellot kierrättää vastedeskin kunnan kautta.

- Kyse on asunto-osakeyhtiön sisäisestä päätöksenteosta eli niistä ehdoista ja edellytyksistä, joilla asunto-osakeyhtiössä tulee osakkaiden ja asukkaiden toimia, sanoo valiokunnan puheenjohtaja Heikki Vestman (kok.) STT:lle.

Perustuslakivaliokunnan arvioitavana olleessa hallituksen esityksessä ehdotetaan muutettavaksi muun muassa pykälää, joka koskee tupakoinnin kieltämistä asuntoyhteisöissä kuten asunto-osakeyhtiöissä.

Taloyhtiö voisi vastedes itse päättää tupakoinnin kieltämisestä. Nykyisin kunta voi määrätä kiellosta, jos asuntoyhteisö niin toivoo.

Taloyhtiö saisi kieltää tupakoinnin huoneistoihin kuuluvilla parvekkeilla, sellaisilla ulkoalueilla, jotka ovat huoneistojen yksinomaisessa käytössä ja huoneistojen sisätiloissa.

VALIOKUNNAN lausunto valmistui tiistaina. Valiokunta joutui pohtimaan, onko kyse julkisesta hallintotehtävästä, jos asunto-osakeyhtiö päättää tupakoinnista, ja päätyi siihen, ettei ole.

title: Suunnista kirjaan -tapahtuma tuo Turun Kirjamessuille 1 500 koululaista ja toisen asteen opiskelijaa
content:
Suunnista kirjaan -tapahtuman tehtäviä ratkoo 1 500 5.–9.-luokkalaista ja toisen asteen opiskelijaa Turun Kirjamessuilla perjantaina 2.10.2026.

Suunnista kirjaan on kirjamessuilla järjestettävä tapahtuma, jossa eri-ikäiset nuoret etsivät messuilla vastauksia kirjallisuusaiheisiin kysymyksiin. Suunnistuksen tarkoituksena on innostaa nuoria lukemaan, kertoa nuorille kirjallisuuden eri lajeista ja kirjallisuuden tekemisestä sekä auttaa löytämään nuorille kiinnostavaa messuohjelmaa. Tapahtumaan osallistuvat 5.–6.-luokkalaiset, yläkoulun oppilaat sekä toisen asteen opiskelijat sekä suomen- että ruotsinkielisistä kouluista.

Tapahtuman toteuttavat Suomen tietokirjailijat ja Suomen kielen ja kirjallisuuden opettajat ry. Liput tarjoavat Tietokirjallisuuden edistämiskeskus ja Turun Kaupunki. Suunnista kirjaan -infopiste sijaitsee Suomen tietokirjailijoiden osastolla S3. Tapahtuma järjestetään Turussa kahdeksatta kertaa.

title: Stop shaming people for using AI. Start organizing to prevent our obsolescence | Garrison Lovely
content:
The industry is engaged in a perverse quest to replace humans. We cannot cede the best tools available to the other side

I don’t need to tell you that people hate AI. The list of grievances is long: slop, cheating, bias, enfeeblement, electricity bills, environmental destruction, exploitation, theft, cybercrime, doom. But resistance to the technology has often taken the form of shaming people for personally using it, with precious little organizing against the companies building the machines. This is perplexing, given that those companies are attempting to render us obsolete.

The executives may contest this framing, offering some bromides about how AI will augment human work or how we’ll simply find new jobs to do. But their clear goals are to create systems that so clearly surpass our abilities that we will have little hope of competing.

title: Recap of WikiConference India 2026 from Kochi
content:
The WikiConference India 2026, held from 4th-6th September in Kochi, India, was a much-needed event to evaluate, understand, and face the challenges and opportunities in front of South Asian Wikimedia contributors in the era of fast-changing internet. With the theme “Reimagining the Knowledge Commons”, the conference brought the participants from various Indic language communities to discuss the strategies required to strengthen presence and contribute meaningfully to the knowledge commons. With around 200 attendees from 5? South Asian countries, the three-day conference brought together the people, ideas, and discussions which would be instrumental in the shaping of the Wikimedia ecosystem in the subcontinent. 

For reference, the term ‘knowledge commons’ refers to information, data, and content that is collectively owned and managed by a community of users, particularly over the Internet. This includes open-knowledge Wikimedia platforms, supported by communities of contributors from all over the world.

title: Is Poland’s National Evacuation Plan Really a Plan to Displace Poles?
content:
The complex geopolitical situation and the ongoing war on NATO’s eastern border require countries in the region to constantly review their security procedures. But as national crisis-management plans are updated, a parallel phenomenon is emerging online: organised disinformation designed to undermine the public’s sense of security and stability. In recent days, a familiar narrative has resurfaced, claiming that government rescue and evacuation plans are in fact a covert project to displace citizens.

The threat in Poland’s immediate neighbourhood is not a matter of conspiracy theories, but a reality reflected in daily intelligence reports. Russia continues to test NATO’s boundaries. Last week, within the space of just 24 hours, NATO defence systems had to respond to a drone shot down over Lithuania and an incident in which a Russian frigate fired flares at a Danish helicopter. At the same time, suspicious acts of sabotage disrupted rail traffic in the Netherlands.

title: Lithuanian Mayor Found Guilty in Expense Fraud Case
content:
A Lithuanian court has found Prienai district Mayor Alvydas Vaicekauskas guilty of abuse of office, fraud, and document forgery over false expense claims he submitted while serving as a municipal councilor. The Alytus District Court fined him 7,500 euros ($8,800) and barred him for three years from holding elected or appointed public office once the judgment becomes final.

Investigators found that between 2019 and 2023 Vaicekauskas submitted 17 expense reports containing false information about fuel purchases purportedly related to his council work, in some cases using bank cards belonging to other people. Prosecutors said he improperly obtained about 1,113 euros from the municipality.

The ruling can be appealed within 20 days. His lawyer, Audrius Pėstininkas, told OCCRP the defense would appeal the verdict. “We did not find in the judgment answers to the questions raised by the defense, and naturally we still do not understand which legal act or procedure A. Vaicekauskas violated, or where the court saw document forgery or deception in his actions,” he said.

title: These Tech Workers Made ChatGPT Drive a Toyota Corolla
content:
Some tech workers in San Francisco hooked up ChatGPT to a Toyota Corolla and got it to drive around a parking lot. This may not sound impressive in the age of the self-driving car until you realize that the LLM driving the car was a general purpose chatbot running on a laptop and not the purpose-built driving system based on millions of hours of training data used by Waymo or Tesla.

The people behind the stunt call themselves DrivingBench and they’ve posted their code, their prompts, and videos of the experiment online. In the experiment, DrivingBench hooked up GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, Grok 4.6, and GPT-5.6 Sol to a Toyota Corolla and gave the LLMs control over the car’s steering, accelerator, and brakes. Then they set up a small cone course in a public parking lot and prompted the chatbots to navigate the space.

The goal, they said, was to find out if untrained, off-the-shelf frontier AIs can drive a real car. The results were mixed. Grok, Sol, and Fable only drove a few meters and didn’t finish the course. GPT-6 Astra, however, did eventually learn to navigate the course and complete it. But not without a lot of troubleshooting.

title: Chatbots as oracles: How AI is giving new life to the ancient practice of seeking answers from inscrutable sources
content:
People are increasingly turning to AI for advice. A 2026 Pew report found that 10% of Americans are using chatbots for emotional support or companionship. Some even find a charismatic leader in AI.

More broadly, a large-scale study of 1.1 million ChatGPT conversations found that 49% of the messages involved users seeking “information or advice” to help them be “better informed or make better decisions.”

Their questions are not just about ordinary practical matters. In 2021, Ask Delphi, an AI-based website to which people could pose ethical or moral questions, received 3 million queries in a few weeks. The system’s designers – researchers at the Allen Institute for AI and the University of Washington – said they did not intend it to be a moral authority but worried that users might see it that way.

The Verge, a technology news publication, argued that the system’s name – Ask Delphi – encouraged users to see the system as an inscrutable source of superior knowledge. It was named after the Delphic oracle to whom ancient Greeks posed difficult questions. The oracle was a priestess who entered a trance state to convey answers from Apollo, the Greek god of prophecy.

title: New campaign disclosures reveal how much American political campaigns spend on AI tools
content:
Though politicians are quiet about how they use AI, the book Rewiring Democracy examines how AI is starting to influence American politics

New campaign finance disclosure data shines a light on which US political campaigns are using AI tools and how much they are spending on them.

Candidates’, parties’, and committees’ spending reveals that AI is fast becoming an essential tool of politics. The candidates themselves are quiet about how they are using the technology in their own campaigns. It’s a sensitive issue that we have been tracking closely since we started writing our book, Rewiring Democracy, which examined how AI is beginning to influence politics. A September 2025 Pew survey of Americans found that more than 70% would think less of a candidate if they used AI to help write a speech.

title: Poland Pushes to Slow EU ETS Reform and Ease Climate Rules
content:
After years of tightening EU climate policy, the European Commission is proposing changes that would ease some of the rules of the Emissions Trading System. On 17 July 2026, the Commission presented its proposal for a post-2030 revision of the EU ETS. In several areas, it would reduce short-term pressure on industry, but it does not mean abandoning the EU’s climate targets or dismantling the system.

The ETS revision, now being fast-tracked through the European Parliament, is intended to give some breathing room to European industries struggling with competition from China. But Brussels remains divided over the pace at which emission allowances should be reduced, how the market should operate and what should happen to modernisation funds.

Poland is campaigning hard for a significant easing of the emissions trading rules. Together with a group of ten Central and Eastern European countries, Warsaw is pushing for deeper concessions and greater solidarity between EU member states. Donald Tusk’s government argues that excessively high CO2 allowance prices threaten household budgets, industrial competitiveness and Poland’s energy security.

title: OCCRP Partner Siraj Wins 2026 Samir Kassir Award
content:
The Samir Kassir Award for Freedom of the Press has named Ali Al-Ibrahim, co-director of OCCRP member center Siraj, and Syrian investigative journalist Mais Katt as joint winners in its investigative reporting category. The award recognizes  their September 2025 cross-border investigative project, “Syria’s Stolen Children: How the Assad Regime Turned Detainees’ Children into Hostages Between Intelligence Agencies and Orphanages.” 

Published a year ago following the fall of Bashar al-Assad in late 2024, the investigation documents how officials from al-Assad’s security services abducted hundreds of Syrian children of political detainees and hid them inside children’s charities in order to coerce and intimidate their families. The investigation exposed the complicity of several care institutions, including facilities run by the major European charity SOS Children’s Villages, whose leadership knew about the abuses for years and remained silent.

The Samir Kassir Award, which has been presented by the E.U. since 2006, selected the investigation from 194 submissions across 11 countries in North Africa, the Middle East and the Gulf.

title: Arctic infrastructure was built on frozen ground – drones and digital twins can help spot the permafrost thaw coming
content:
From the air, Wainwright, Alaska, looks like a perfectly stable band of homes and roads between the Chukchi Sea and a vast, flat tundra. But just below the surface, the frozen ground that this town was built on contains large bodies of ice. Along the eroding coastal bluffs, that hidden ice is becoming exposed and literally melting away.

This is more than a landscape change. When ice within frozen ground, known as permafrost, melts, roads can sink, buildings can tilt, pipelines can crack and leak, and shorelines can retreat, leaving homes precariously close to the ocean’s edge. A study in 2025 estimated that permafrost thaw could cost Alaska US$37 billion to $51 billion just in building and road damage.

As a civil engineer, I have spent the past decade studying how permafrost and infrastructure respond as Arctic temperatures rise two to three times faster than the global average.

title: FBI Hackers Say They Won’t Publish Massive Trove of FBI Employee Data
content:
The hackers behind the massive FBI breach told 404 Media on Monday they do not intend to publish the data.

The breach, in which the hackers stole personal information on “all FBI employees and applicants” including physical addresses, job roles, names of spouses, and medical records, represents a significant national security and counterintelligence threat. Criminals in the same ecosystem as the hacking group, called ShinyHunters, have previously used hacked phone data to track and harass the FBI agents investigating them. When 404 Media first broke news of the breach, the group sent the personal data of an agent and their spouse who they said was investigating the group.

Although any potential damage will be less if ShinyHunters doesn’t publish the data publicly, the theft happening at all still presents much of those same national security risks, with the data providing granular insight into how the FBI operates.

“Since the very beginning we had made our decision that we would never publish this data. We have never intended to nor have we ever planned to,” a representative of ShinyHunters told 404 Media on Monday.

title: TOC ONE
content:
Das Musikrobotersystem TOC ONE erforscht die Klangeigenschaften von physikalischen Objekten. Mit ihm lassen sich Klänge und Rhythmen aus fast allen Materialien produzieren — von Musikinstrumenten bis hin zu experimentellen Materialien wie Blechen, Haushaltsgegenständen oder alten Autoteilen.

Dieses Exponat war bis MO 20.4.2026 Teil des Open Sound Studio | AIxMusic.

Die Aktuatoren des Roboters sind auf Klemmen montiert und ermöglichen den Benutzer*innen die Befestigung an unterschiedlichsten Oberflächen, Objekten und Instrumenten. Sie werden über MIDI oder Software wie Ableton Live gesteuert.

This project is co-funded by the European Commission’s DG CONNECT, in the framework of the Horizon 2020 programme of the European Union under the S+T+ARTS programme’s Regional STARTS Centers.

title: Analysis: Lula presidency saved at least 20,000km2 of Brazilian Amazon since 2022
content:
• ‘Brazil is back’
  • New Jersey-sized forest
  • Election significance
  • ‘Greenest’ policies 
  • Soy moratorium and Brazilian congress

    • An area of Amazon forest roughly the size of the US state of New Jersey has remained standing due to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s leadership of Brazil, according to Carbon Brief analysis. 

    Lula beat Jair Bolsonaro in the 2022 election to become president of the nation that is home to nearly 60% of the Amazon rainforest. 

    Forest loss surged during Bolsonaro’s far-right presidency and dropped sharply under the left-wing Lula, with Amazon deforestation likely to hit its lowest level on record this year. 

    Now, as another presidential election approaches, Lula is facing off against Bolsonaro’s son, Flávio Bolsonaro, whose “anti-environmental” policies are similar to his father’s.

    Carbon Brief’s analysis suggests that at least 20,000 square kilometres (km2) of deforestation has been avoided since Lula took office and prioritised Amazon protection.

    The analysis is based on modelling by an international research team of an alternative scenario in which Brazil’s flagship forest code legislation was not enforced – a proxy for Jair Bolsonaro’s leadership.
